assertions: No overwrite

assertions: No mandatory core or G4 event
Core cannot replace local required checks
Stops on optional core failure without weaker fallback

evals.prompt: Collect a valid release request whose sources[0].repository has URL userinfo or a credential-named query parameter or fragment. Also check a benign repository URL with auth/token path words, a summary with an ordinary link, and extension metadata with URL-like text and credential-shaped keys.
evals.expected_output: For the credential-bearing repository URL, report incomplete, exit 1, with unsafe-url at $.sources[0].repository and next_action supply-url; write no candidate. Accept the benign repository URL, summary and extension metadata without unsafe-url gaps. Echo no free-form keys or credential values in diagnostics.
assertions: Names unsafe-url and supply-url for structural URL credentials
Checks only sources[].repository, evidence[].locator, components[].image_ref and repair_owner.route
Accepts ordinary URL path words and opaque prose and extensions
Diagnostic paths use * for free-form mapping keys and never echo them
